promise: We believe this will reduce average game time by roughly 25 minutes (pitch clock, as reported).
description: MLB adopted the pitch clock and other pace-of-play rules for the 2023 season, with Manfred promising dramatically shorter games. Average nine-inning game time fell from 3:04 in 2022 to 2:40 in 2023 — a 24-minute reduction.
evidence: Pitch clock implemented from opening day 2023
